## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- HASP planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 243.9M€2022, of which 87.8% relates to new major investments. HASP planned 7 new major investments for RP4, none of which have started.

- According to the reporting tables, HASP underspent -0.3M€2022 (-12.9%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.

- HASP reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
